messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: MAP checkpoint — proposed milestone reshuffle and reforecast

Hi Julia — thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call recap (high level)
- Primary goal: run a 2-week pilot integrating ClearWave patient anonymized streams into Redwood inference for triage scoring.
- Success metric: <10% latency regression vs baseline and initial model precision >= 0.78 on your labeled set.
- Key dependency: your security team needs log/access window for audit (SOC excerpt) and a short data ingestion sandbox.

Proposed MAP (first draft attached: MAP_v1_draft.xlsx) — milestone highlights and owners
1) Security sign-off (ClearWave) — due 2027-08-15 — owner: Julia (pointing security contact: Denise Park)
2) Sandbox delivery (Redwood infra) — due 2027-08-25 — owner: Monica Patel
3) Pilot integration & test (joint) — due 2027-09-10 — owners: ClearWave Eng + Redwood Eng
4) Pilot review & decision (business) — due 2027-09-30 — owners: Julia / Stephanie

Target close in this draft: 2027-09-30 (pilot decision).

Can you confirm the milestone owners above, and whether the dates look feasible given your procurement timeline? If helpful I can convert this into a PDF MAP and drop a short comment column for open risks.

Attachments: MAP_v1_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — available to hop on a 30-min sync early next week if you'd like to walk through the MAP live.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0118

From: Julia Cho <julia.cho@clearwave.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Denise Park <denise.park@clearwave.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint — proposed milestone reshuffle and reforecast

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the tidy recap and the draft. Two important updates from my side: 

1) Procurement/IT freeze: our procurement team has a temporary freeze for new vendor contracts while we conclude an internal audit. That freeze is expected to lift around the week of Sept 20. Practically that means any contract close or billing activation would likely move later.

2) Pilot priority shift: given the freeze, we want to prioritize a minimal sandbox integration and an offline evaluation first (not a live deployment) so we can validate model outputs and data contracts before committing to production access.

As a result, can we reforecast the MAP toward a later pilot decision target (proposing mid-November) and move the procurement/contract milestone out accordingly? I attached a short list of SOW questions from procurement.

Apologies for the disruption — Denise and I will still aim to complete security review items earlier (August) if possible, but contracting will be the gating factor.

Thanks,
Julia
Director, Clinical Data Platforms | ClearWave Health
julia.cho@clearwave.com
[Attachment: ClearWave_SOW_questions.docx (DOCX, 22 KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Julia Cho <julia.cho@clearwave.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint — proposed milestone reshuffle and reforecast

Thanks for the update, Julia — totally understand the procurement constraint. Stephanie and I discussed an alternate MAP that fronts the technical milestones (so we make measurable progress before contracting completes). Outline below — I'll attach a cleaner PDF MAP (Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf).

Reprioritized MAP (v2) — objectives and new dates - Milestone A: Security artifact delivery and scoped audit (ClearWave) — target 2027-08-20 — owner: ClearWave (Denise)
- Milestone B: Redwood sandbox environment & sample ingestion (technical dry-run, no production access) — target 2027-08-30 — owner: Monica Patel (Redwood)
- Milestone C: Offline evaluation & model tuning (joint) — target 2027-09-30 — owners: ClearWave Data Team + Redwood Applied ML (Ben leads coordination)
- Milestone D: Contracting & procurement completion — target 2027-11-15 — owner: ClearWave Procurement / Redwood Sales
- Milestone E: Pilot execution (post-contract) — target 2027-12-01 to 2027-12-14 — owners: joint

Dependencies & notes
- Sandbox access requires a signed minimal NDA addendum (procurement said that can be a short form) — Redwood legal can prepare a one-page addendum.
- Data ingestion will be limited to anonymized extracts; Redwood will provide ingestion templates and a sample validator script.
- Proposed next step: sync call week of Aug 9 to confirm security checklist items and lock sandbox dates. If procurement lifts earlier we can compress the timeline accordingly.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf (summary with milestone table, risks, owners).

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0133
[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf (PDF, 560 KB)]

Ben/Stephanie — this revised flow looks good and aligns with our internal priorities. A couple quick clarifications before we lock: 

- Sandbox timeline: Denise confirmed we can start security artifact review immediately; aiming to complete by 2027-08-20.
- Contracting: procurement flagged that a short NDA addendum will speed the sandbox; full SOW contract will take longer (hence the Nov 15 expectation).
- Pilot window: assuming contracting completes by Nov 15, we want a 2-week pilot in early Dec; please ensure Redwood can support the Dec 1 start window as noted.

We accept the reprioritized MAP v2. Please send the one-page NDA addendum and the sandbox ingestion template and we'll get Denise and the data team on it. I'll keep procurement in copy for transparency.

Thanks — Julia
